standards_review.notes: all 6 commit subjects in c4f5bd54..HEAD follow the git-workflow.md 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format (EPMCDME-15542: <Capitalised description> (EPMCDME-15967))

new module session_money.py carries the Apache 2.0 header and from __future__ import annotations; added public functions/methods are typed with X | None and parameterized generics; llm_service.py only extends an existing typing import with Literal (pre-existing List/Optional not introduced by this change); session money was extracted into its own module (Module Cohesion) rather than grown in the handler, which shrank 1114->1098 lines; reader/rollups growth is SQL for their own read/rollup concern

no auth changes in routers/cli_analytics.py (only handler return-shape unpacking); added SQL f-strings in reader/rollups/ingestor interpolate only module constants and table aliases, session id is bound via $sid; the new logger.warning in session_money.py logs model names only, no credentials; no lossy input normalization introduced

finding_status.notes: kind decision: fix_evidence maps CR-001 to the product-owner outcome 'accept the documented deviation' with a non-empty rationale (YAML cache prices unmaintained; deployments price from LiteLLM model_info, which has the 1h price; gap reported via unpriced_models)
